function.name: make_webapi_call
function.description: Executes a call to a specified Web API endpoint with given parameters and returns the response. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

endpoint.description: The URL of the Web API endpoint to be called.

method.description: The HTTP method to be used for the API call.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request.

Content-Type.description: The media type of the resource being requested or submitted.

params.description: Query parameters to be appended to the endpoint URL.

query.description: The search term for the query.

body.description: The JSON payload to be sent with POST, PUT, or PATCH requests.

data.description: The actual data to be sent in the request body.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for a server response before timing out. This is a float type value.

message.content:
Sure thing! To help you find the perfect 3‑bedroom apartment in Zürich, it would be great to know a bit more about what you’re looking for:

| Detail | Why it matters |
|--------|----------------|
| **Budget** (per month) | Keeps the search focused on listings you can afford. |
| **Preferred districts** (e.g., Zürich‑N, Zürich‑O, Wiedikon, Enge, etc.) | Zürich is diverse; some areas are more family‑friendly, others more vibrant. |
| **Move‑in date** | Some listings are available immediately, others a few months away. |
| **Desired amenities** (e.g., balcony, parking, elevator, pet‑friendly) | Helps narrow down options that fit your lifestyle. |
| **Size preference** (e.g., minimum square footage) | Ensures the apartment feels spacious enough for three bedrooms. |

If you can share any of these details, I’ll be able to pull up the most relevant listings for you. In the meantime, here are a few reliable platforms where you can start your search:

1. **[Homegate](https://www.homegate.ch/en)** – Switzerland’s largest real‑estate portal. Use the “Apartment” filter, set “3 rooms” and “Zürich” as the city.  
2. **[Immoscout24](https://www.immoscout24.ch/en)** – Offers advanced filters (price, district, amenities).  
3. **[Newhome](https://www.newhome.ch/en)** – Focuses on new builds and modern apartments.  
4. **[Zürich‑City‑Housing](https://www.zuerich-city-housing.ch/en)** – City‑run housing options, often with more affordable rents.  

Let me know your preferences, and I can fetch the latest listings for you!
